verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a native, real-time, bidirectional ERP connector. The building blocks are present: statements can be exported in accounting-friendly formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF, CSV, XLSX), and webhook subscriptions exist. With these, a team could build a one-way statement import or a custom event-driven integration, but that requires extra engineering. Missing for 10: named ERP or accounting connectors (e.g. Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite), evidence of real-time push into the ERP, bidirectional sync from the ERP back to Wise, automated journal-entry mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
